info.name: NotifyNow API
info.description: NotifyNow public API. Set `apiKey` (Settings → API keys) and `baseUrl` (your NotifyNow address, e.g. https://wa.notifynow.in) in the collection variables. Guides: /api/docs.

item.name: Getting started
Check an API key (X-API-Key) — account, key id and scopes

request.description: Checks an API key: answers the account id, the key id and its scopes. Any valid key works (no scope needed) — use it as the first call after creating a key. `401` = missing, wrong, expired or revoked key (revocation takes effect within 30 s). Read limit class (600 / min per key).

item.name: Account resources
Call flows (ids for calls and campaigns)

request.description:
Published call flows by default (`status=all` adds drafts and archived ones). Use a flow `id` in `POST /calls` (`flowId`) or `POST /campaigns` (`flowId` / `program`). Only flows whose `triggers` include `campaign` can run in a campaign; `api` for single calls. At most 200 rows, newest first. Read limit class (600 / min per key).

Scope: `resources:read`

item.name: AI agents (ids for agent calls and campaigns)

request.description:
Active AI agents by default (`active=false` lists all). Use an agent `id` as `agentId` in `POST /calls`, `program: { kind: 'agent', id }` in WhatsApp call campaigns, or in `POST /whatsapp/calls`. Prompts, functions and their secrets are never returned. At most 200 rows, newest first. Read limit class (600 / min per key).

Scope: `resources:read`

item.name: Connected WhatsApp numbers (channel ids)

request.description:
Connected WhatsApp numbers of the account. `id` is the `channelId` for template sends, WhatsApp calls and bulk campaigns. `messagesPerSecond` is the bulk-campaign cap of the number (Business App or unconfirmed: 18, Cloud API: 75). `calling.ready` says whether WhatsApp calls can go out now; `unavailableReason` explains why not (e.g. `coexistence`). At most 200 rows, newest first. Read limit class (600 / min per key).

Scope: `resources:read`

Scope: `contacts:read`

item.name: Create a contact (contacts.write). A live duplicate phone / external id → 409 with existingId; a deleted one is revived. `?upsert=phone|externalId` updates the matching contact instead (200). Opt-out / DND are never cleared here.

request.description:
Creates one contact. `phone` is normalised to E.164 (Indian 10-digit numbers get `+91`). A live contact with the same phone or `externalId` answers `409 CONFLICT_DUPLICATE` with the existing id in `details` — or use `POST /contacts?upsert=phone` to update it instead. `variables` are custom field values by key. Write limit class (60 / min per key).

Scope: `contacts:write`

item.name: Create or update up to 1,000 contacts by phone or externalId (contacts.write) — a result per row; one bad row never stops the others. Idempotency-Key optional.

item.name: WhatsApp messages
Send an approved template to a contact or phone (inbox.reply / messages:write) — works outside the 24-hour window; charged like the dashboard (hold, marketing limits, opt-out, DND)

request.description:
Sends an **approved** template (`GET /whatsapp/templates`) to a contact (`contactId`) or a phone (`to`, a contact is created if needed) from `channelId` (default: the account's first connected number). Works outside the 24-hour window. `variables` fill `{{1}}`, `{{2}}`… (or named ones); `header` carries an uploaded media token or a location. The price (template category × destination) is held and charged when Meta bills it. Errors: `TEMPLATE_NOT_APPROVED`, `TEMPLATE_VARIABLES_MISSING`, `CONTACT_OPTED_OUT`, `WALLET_INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE`. `Idempotency-Key` header required: a retry with the same key returns the first answer and never repeats the action. Write limit class (60 / min per key).

Scope: `messages:write`

item.name: Call one contact now (calls.trigger; AI additionally needs flows.read / agents.read; human needs a signed-in user and SIP caller number; Idempotency-Key, 10 / min / user) — configured SIP line or simulated dry-run line; the dial guard applies: 422 CALL_OUTSIDE_WINDOW (details[0].message = next window start), 422 CALL_NOT_ALLOWED (DND / opted out / daily or weekly limit / minimum gap)

request.description:
Calls one contact now on the account's phone line with a published flow (`flowId`, optional `version`) **or** an active AI agent (`agentId`) — ids from `GET /resources/flows` / `/resources/agents`. On the test line the call is simulated and never charged. `variables` seed flow variables / allowed agent values; `externalRef` comes back in webhooks. Checks: calling window, DND / opt-out, call caps, wallet (`WALLET_INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE`), concurrency (`CALL_LIMIT_REACHED`), `NUMBER_NOT_ALLOWED`. `Idempotency-Key` header required: a retry with the same key returns the first answer and never repeats the action. Write limit class (60 / min per key).

Scope: `calls:write`
